prompts.battleships: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: Space Fleet game modeling reference board, two independent Tier 5 battleships, each a clear 3/4 view plus small top and side silhouette. Neutral dark studio, bright readable modeling light, gray metal, no scene or cinematic explosions, restrained detail, broad chamfered volumes for blockout. Label only HIMALAYA / NERGAL. HIMALAYA Earth: monumental broad stepped armored bow, thick lateral armored shoulders, central low citadel, dorsal TWO twin railgun turrets at different longitudinal positions plus ONE ventral twin turret, eight small point defense turrets, broad horizontal aft cooling wings, four round engines in 2x2 cluster, muted ivory gray/navy and small blue lights. 1200m class. NERGAL Mars: 1080m long slender spear bow, open aft truss engineering frame with supported outer drive pods, ONE dorsal very long twin railgun and ONE ventral twin railgun, four small PD turrets, aft tall sensor mast, exposed vertical red copper cooling panels, four engines, dark gray with rust red bands and amber lights. All parts physically attached, symmetric mechanical construction, no aircraft wings, no text panels. Strong differences in the actual primary silhouette, not only color. Keep all weapons as conventional physical mounts. This is a feasible first 3D blockout reference, not a final microdetail design.
prompts.cruisers: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: single Space Fleet T5 cruiser modeling comparison board with four separated 3/4 views, labeled AMAZON, NIMBUS, MARINERIS, HELLAS. Industrial hard surface ships, clean basic volumes, neutral charcoal studio, readable even light. All four elongated about 300m, different silhouettes, two twin railgun turrets one dorsal forward and one ventral forward, functional physically connected equipment. Earth AMAZON: broad single armored wedge ram prow, stepped central gun citadel, bulky rectangular aft engineering shoulders, blue-gray metal, broad horizontal radiator wings. Earth NIMBUS: narrow central keel and broad connected swept lateral defense decks projecting forward and aft with six small PD turrets, drone cradles, low bridge, horizontal thin radiators, pale gray navy accents. Mars MARINERIS: very slender needle prow flanked by two long tapering armor rails, deep open midship truss space, tall aft sensor mast, twin long gun barrels, exposed vertical radiators, rust red bands. Mars HELLAS: short narrow spear bow, wider rear twin long missile magazine hulls with modular dorsal VLS cells, low central bridge, many large flush launch caps, compact aft engines, dark gray red bands. Two engines per cruiser. No extra independent ships or disconnected parts; clear large shapes, low microdetail, no giant text panels, not an illustration of a sea warship.
prompts.small: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: Space Fleet T5 small spacecraft modeling reference board, four separated 3/4 views, simple readable hard-surface volumes to be built in Blender. Labels HAEDONGCHEONG, POLARIS, SCHIAPARELLI, ENYO. Gray studio backdrop, balanced bright lighting, no action or explosions. All long front nose with single central fixed electromagnetic gun and two parallel accelerator rails, manned cockpit, two engine nacelles at rear, physically connected and mirrored hardware. HAEDONGCHEONG Earth defense interceptor: broad cranked delta wings with clipped tips, wide armored shoulder, small canard, twin upright tail fins, TWO small defensive turrets upper and lower rear, concealed belly torpedoes, blue gray navy details. POLARIS Earth recon: distinctive long straight transverse sensor wing, two large outward sensor pods at wing ends, lower compact engine pods, tall twin sensor fins and dorsal six-probe cassette, low canopy, blue gray. SCHIAPARELLI Mars interceptor: very narrow dart fuselage with close pair of engines and steeply swept thin wings, forward canards, low outward canted fins, ONE dorsal rear defensive turret, amber accents rust red gray. ENYO Mars assault: thick keel with six-cell torpedo storage block below fuselage, heavy clipped angular wings and deep outboard engine nacelles, tall rear fins, ONE dorsal rear turret, rust red armored bands. Keep clear distinct silhouettes without changing overall length class: Earth30m Mars26m. Avoid ornamental guns, no dense bolts or labels, plausible low-poly modeling plan.
